description:
Returns a list of Document Revisions for a Project.

Pass `view=ids_only` to receive an array of Document Revision ids instead of full objects.

parameters.name: exclude_placeholders
parameters.description: If true, filters out revisions where item_content=Placeholder from the results

parameters.name: view

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language for the response to be translated into

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Comma-separated set of attributes to sort the list of records by.

200.description: Full revision objects, or an array of ids when `view=ids_only`.

Bad Request

Possible reason codes:
